question: How much does replacing PVDF with PVDF latex and CMC raise the solids content of NMC 532 slurries, and by what share does the higher solids content cut the primary drying time of the graphite coating?
rendered: Replacing the polyvinylidene diﬂuoride (PVDF) binder with PVDF latex and carboxymethylcellulose (CMC) increases the solid content from 45 wt% to 65 wt%. The higher solid content dramatically shortens the primary drying time (i.e. from 51 s to 34 s for a graphite coating with a loading of 10 mg/cm2).
